en:
Is Uncle Kaz going to end up
 in prison again?

If he gets himself a decent lawyer,
he
 should get off without jail time, but...
...that all depends on Kiryu.
Way to dodge the question.

Kiryu and I have known
each other for a long time.

I think by now, I have a pretty
good idea of how he thinks.
Where... Where am I...?

(I must still be alive if
 they're here with me...)
Kiryu-chan!

Lieutenant advisor to the Tojo Clan...
Goro Majima. The Mad Dog of Shimano.

No matter how many times we've fought since
I retired, I can still never get a read on him.
For whatever reason, our fates are tied.

These days he's made a name for himself
as a high-ranking officer of the Tojo Clan.

He's also very close to another
 Tojo Clan
officer, his sworn brother, Taiga Saejima.

CEO of the Kamurocho-based loan
company Sky Finance... Shun Akiyama.

He was apparently a banking elite...
until he was framed for embezzlement.

That hit him so hard that he was
even homeless for a time.

But after investing a small windfall, his
net worth grew to over 100 billion yen.

I first met him through 
Saejima's sister, Yasuko.

In Osaka, where Haruka was working as an idol,
he watched over her in my place.

A legendary Tojo Clan yakuza said to have
killed eighteen of his foes... Taiga Saejima.

When we first met, Saejima was
on the lam as a prison escapee.

After confronting the truth of the eighteen murders,
he started the Saejima Family under the Tojo Clan.

But, he got sucked into an Omi Alliance
plot in 2012 after escaping prison again.

Both of us were targeted as
representatives of the Tojo Clan.

A girl who was orphaned by
the only woman I ever loved.

When we met, she was just a child caught
in the middle of a brutal yakuza war.

She was the only emotional support I had
as I lost nearly everyone dear to me.
If there's one thing I'm proud of in life...

...It's my decision to take her in and
raise her as my own daughter.

The only son of Sohei Dojima, a ranking
Tojo Clan officer and my yakuza patriarch.

Even though Daigo wanted to distance
himself from the underworld...

...I forced him back into action as
the sixth chairman of the Tojo Clan.

If anyone can unify the 25,000 members
of the Tojo Clan, it's Daigo Dojima.

I don't just believe that, though.
Daigo has proven it.

He used to be an elite police detective,
but his career derailed when he met me.

Over the years I've known him, he's acted
as both a partner and a good friend.

Having raised his daughter alone
as a single father...

...I expect Date-san to continue fighting
to keep justice alive in Kamurocho.

Taichi, Koji, Mitsuo, Shiro,
Ayako, Izumi, Riona, Eri.

As an orphan myself, I decided to start
the Morning Glory orphanage in Okinawa.

It's hard to describe how much Haruka and
these kids have helped me in life...

...But if I want to live with them in peace
 again,
there's something I need to do.
Something that will take a long time...
Are you awake, Fourth Chairman?
Daigo?

Looks like things aren't going so well
for either of us, Sixth Chairman.
You're better off than me, Kiryu-san.

Maybe I am.
So, you need something?

I do. I heard some rumors about
you recently, Kiryu-san.

If it's all right with you, I'd like to
get some fresh air while we talk.

I'm sure you know what I've heard.
It's about you going to jail, Kiryu-san.

With a decent lawyer, you could avoid that
entirely. So why exactly won't you?
So I can go back in peace.
You mean to Morning Glory, yes?

If I went back to Okinawa now, there'd be
no peace for Haruka and those kids.

No matter how I spin it, I'm ex-yakuza...
and now Haruka is tied to that.

The media's going to be even more vigilant
now that society has me in the spotlight.

Haruka and I can handle that, but the
kids at Morning Glory shouldn't have to.

If I want to greet them with my head
held high, I need to take responsibility.
I understand that.

But if you really do go to prison,
who knows how long you'll be in for?

You intend to make Haruka-chan and
the
 others wait for you that whole time?
Kiryu-san... You're comfortable with that?

Haruka and I are the center of attention
right now. The timing couldn't be better.

Once I'm out, I'll be able to
 walk free
with a clear conscience.

On that Japan Dome stage, Haruka
took pride in calling me her family.

I need to know I deserve that honor
before going back to the orphanage.

So about this search for Haruka-chan...
What are you going to do, Uncle Kaz?

Well, I'm going to start by talking to
an acquaintance of mine from Kamurocho.
Who's that?

A man named Akiyama. He's helped
Haruka before in both Osaka and Kamurocho.

There's a chance he's heard
something about where she is.
I'll go give him a call now.

(I should give Akiyama a call. He might
have heard something about Haruka.)

The number you have dialed
is currently out of service.

Please confirm you have the
correct number and try again.

(Did Akiyama get a new phone number?
Dammit, what's going on...?)

Uncle Kaz. Did you manage to get
in touch with that Akiyama guy?
No, it looks like his number changed.
What? No...

If his phone's cut off, I may have to
go to Kamurocho and find him myself.

So then... does that mean you're
going to be leaving us here again?

Ayako-chan is the worst.
I can't believe she didn't tell us.

You shouldn't blame her for this. What
happened with Haruka wasn't her fault.

Put yourself in Ayako's shoes. It must
have been hard keeping it a secret.
I mean, I know that...

...But I just wish she would've at
least told her family the truth.
I should start getting dinner ready soon.
Ah, Uncle Kaz.

You're in charge of dinner prep, huh?
Anything I can do to help?

No, I'll be fine.
I can do it all by myself!

Besides, I should be more independent.
I can't rely on grown-ups for everything.
Good point.
Um, Uncle Kaz...

Even if you do manage to
find Haruka-chan somehow...

...We still don't know that she'll
want to come back with you, right?

Don't think like that. If I can talk to her,
I know she'll want to come back.
No need to worry about that.
Oh, Uncle Kaz!

Already lunchtime for Mame, huh?
He hasn't slowed down at all.

Not yet, Mame.
Wait for the magic word.
Go!

I wonder what Haruka-chan's doing
now... You think she's eating good?

I'm sure she's doing fine.
She must be up in Kamurocho.
I hope you're right.
Oh, Uncle Kaz.
I've done a bunch of research online...

...but no one seems to have anything
on where Haruka might be these days.
She's gone dark on social media, too.
Got it. Thanks for trying.

For now, my best lead is getting in touch
with an acquaintance in Kamurocho.

If anyone's going to know
where Haruka is, it's him.

Okay. I'll keep an eye on the net
to see if anything pops up.

Uncle Kaz...
What do you think
 I should do?

Don't worry about Haruka.
Just focus on your baseball.
I promise I'll bring her back.

And once I do, we'll all come cheer for
you together. Give it all you got, okay?
I will.

Hey, um... When was the last time
you saw Haruka-chan, Uncle Kaz?

Three years ago. She came to see me
while I was still behind bars.

She said everyone here at
Morning Glory was doing well, though.

Even back then, I'm sure she was worried
about how you guys were coping.

This could have all been avoided if
I'd just noticed it... I'm so sorry.
It's not your fault, Uncle Kaz.

But we've gotta find Haruka soon.
What if she's caught up in something shady?

Right. I promise I'll find her...
and I'll bring her back, too.

I never thought Haruka-chan would be
so worried about all of us here.
And I didn't even notice...
It's okay.
Man, Haruka-chan worries way too much!

Uncle Kaz! You better talk some sense
into her when you figure out where she is!

Let her know we don't mind having her
around, no matter what happens!

Yeah, I'll tell her soon enough.
Don't worry.
(I can't let them keep worrying like this.)
(I just need to find Haruka, fast.)
(All right... Tomorrow I'll head up to Kamurocho.)
Well, I'm heading out.

Next time you're gonna be back,
let us know first, okay?
It'll be cleaner if you give us some notice.

Funny you say that.
When was the last time you cleaned, Shiro?

You're going to Kamurocho, right?
Is it gonna be dangerous, Uncle Kaz?

Once I find Akiyama,
I'll get right out of there.
I doubt I'll be there long.

Don't get too upset with Haruka-chan
once you find her, Uncle Kaz.

I won't. Mitsuo, good luck with
your baseball training.

And Taichi, Koji, Shiro,
Eri, Riona, Izumi, Ayako...

I won't make you wait long this time.
Haruka and I will be back soon, I promise.
Right, I almost forgot Mame.

I'm looking forward to seeing everyone
smile again. Goodbye for now.

(Akiyama's company, Sky Finance, is on
Tenkaichi Street. I should get going.)

(No matter how many years pass, Kamurocho
stays the same. There's always trouble.)
Hey, stop right there!
I knew it was you, Kiryu!

What are you doing here?
When did you get out?
Just the other day, actually.

Seriously? I kept telling them to
let me know when you'd get out.
Nobody said a damn word to me.

Eh, all's well that ends well.
We still
 ended up finding each other.
Hey, you've aged.

It's finally catching up to me.
Not that you can talk.
Heh, fair enough.

It's been too long, Kiryu.
Glad you made it through all that.

Though I would've thought you'd
head to Okinawa after getting out.
I actually just came from there.
Huh, that so?
Looks like you're still swamped, Date-san.

There's been a murder. A Tojo guy
stabbed to death by a Chinese immigrant.

Kamurocho's getting torn apart by a war
between the Tojo Clan and the triads.
The Chinese mafia?

Right. A lot went down while
you were behind bars.

Speaking of, did you hear about
the big Kamurocho fire last year?
Yeah, when I was in prison.

That fire finally cost the Tojo Clan
their chokehold on Kamurocho.

Little Asia went up in smoke, and this
Saio Triad smelled blood in the water.

Their war with the Tojo Clan broke out
soon after. Even civilians are fair game now.

The cops got pretty desperate to resolve it,
so they
 pinned the whole thing on the Tojo Clan.

Both Majima and Daigo Dojima
 have been arrested.

You hadn't heard?
That was almost
 six months ago.

If they got Daigo, who's calling
the shots for the Tojo Clan?

Some advisor at the headquarters level...
Man named Sugai. You know him?

Not personally. Pretty sure he's been
around since the second chairman, though.

Yup, that's the guy.
Nailed it.

Anyway, you should probably stay as far
away as you can from this Tojo Clan mess.

That's what landed you in prison in the
first place. Let's change the subject.

How's Haruka doing? Come to think of it,
why are you even in Kamurocho?
I'm here to find Akiyama.

More specifically, I need to ask him
if he knows where Haruka is.
You lost Haruka?

She up and left Okinawa a while back.
Nobody knows where she is.
The kids at Morning Glory just told me.

I was thinking Akiyama might know something,
but his number's been disconnected.

You know, I've been wondering about him.
Did you hear he closed up shop?
Wait, he shut down Sky Finance?

Apparently it's temporary. I bet
 he's
still in Kamurocho somewhere.

That said, I've heard whispers that
the triads are after him.

Sorry, but I've got to be getting back.
I'll call you later, okay? We can talk then.
Yeah, sounds good.

Oh, and steer clear of Little Asia.
The triads are getting pretty ballsy.
Guy like you shouldn't even go near it.

Right, I'll be careful.
Thanks for everything, Date-san.
'Course. See you around.
(So, Akiyama closed Sky Finance...)

(It's not like I have any other leads though,
so I'll just check it out anyway.)

(If I remember, it was on the fourth floor of
the Serena building. The stairs are in the back...)

(Maybe I should hit up some of the stores
I know around town for more info.)
(This is where Sky Finance used to be...)

(It says they're accepting tenant applications.
I guess Akiyama really did sell the company.)

Wait, did you seriously get hammered
over in Little Asia last night?
Y-Yeah. I started drinking around here...

...but then before I knew it, I was
smack dab in the middle of Little Asia.

What were you thinking? Don't you
know how dangerous that place is?

Once I realized, I just put my money
on the counter and snuck out.

You didn't drop a business card
or anything, did you?
N-No, I don't think so.

Good. Can't have the triads kicking our
door down just to get their hands on you.
